about_the_game:
Background Story

The story takes place in a fictional modern world where sports and the arts have been elevated to new heights.

Football is not only a competition, but also a stage where young people pursue their dreams and build bonds.

You will play as Chico Liano, a freshman just entering university. Here, you will meet partners and mentors with distinct personalities, train and compete alongside them, and face the upcoming challenges of your club together.

Gameplay Features

  • 20+ hours of story content on a single route, with multiple characters to pursue. Romance and campus life intertwine to shape your story.

  • Open map exploration with unique gameplay elements, item discoveries, and a wide variety of experiences.

  • Deeper butterfly effects — every detail, whether in the main story or side activities, may alter the course of the narrative.

  • Enhanced visual experience with dozens of full-color CGs, plus over 200 manga-style illustrations bringing the story to life.

  • Full Live2D integration throughout the game, allowing you to feel every subtle shift in the characters’ emotions.

  • And much more—discover all the surprises for yourself!

Character Profiles

Step into a university life that is at once familiar… and unlike anything you’ve ever experienced!

Get ready to embark on a college journey that feels both ordinary and extraordinary.

content_descriptors.notes: 《Football Buddy》contains a small amount of crude language and also involves content such as drinking and urging others to drink.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Football Buddy is an AVG set against the backdrop of modern university life. In an alternate contemporary world, players step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience a story where sports, friendship, and even romance intertwine with multiple characters.
